## #1 — tg_jp — 2010-10-18
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/6373/post-49004>

Toggle Visibility.js

hello

this is a macro script to toggle 'visible in editor' of selected object at object browser. 

[download] -> http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=61

place this script file into ~/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3D/scripts/Macro folder.

update 20101125: now it works recursively.

you can assign shortcut key for this script via 'System Preferences...' -> 'Keyboard' -> 'Keyboard Shortcut'.

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.

Links: http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=61

## #18 — frank beckmann — 2010-11-24
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/6373/post-52001>

There are 5 folders at least to organize scripts when you open the main script folder:
•Tool
•Tag
•Polygonobj
•Macro
•Splineobj

You don´t have to restart Cheetah3d to use a new script: There´s a last menu item at the script list called "Update menu". This will do it.

Cheers
Frank
